payload.posture: Read Isaiah 9:5–9 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the announced child, David’s throne, justice, righteousness, peace, and an unending kingdom are held together. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
